quantile_definition: All rows; numpy linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, same accepted short-run convention; no downsampling
limits: Sequential repetition of 25 frozen public cases; no all-input proof or iid confidence intervals.
Native timer ioctl+exact comparison excludes packing, allocation, RX clearing and row logging; no E2E speedup claim.
Rowwise remaining interval combines uninstrumented work; not a specific copy/validation/scheduler bottleneck measurement.
System-wide meminfo and periodic cpufreq are observations, not per-process leak proof or calibrated frequency.
All 721 thermal dictionaries are empty if thermal_samples=0; do not infer temperatures, absence of throttling or thermal stability.
No physical timeout, in-flight remove, concurrent-request fault or PS-DDR surviving-reset proof.
